  • Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability
  • Education
  • Home improvement
  • Automobiles and motorcycles
  • Health and wellness
  • Medical and clinical fields
  • Digital marketing
  • SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities
  • Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites
  • Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy
  • Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors
  • Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices
  • Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing
  • Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team

Qualifications
  • Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills
  • 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices
  • Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics
  • Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content
  • Portfolio featuring published work preferred
  • Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred

Compensation

Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.

Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate

This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page

After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate

After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate

 

Application Process

Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Are you a talented Senior AI Engineer looking for a remote job that lets you show your skills and get decent compensation? Look no further than Lemon.io — the marketplace that connects you with hand-picked startups in the US and Europe.

 

What we offer:

  • The rate depends on your skills and experience. We've already paid out over $11M to our engineers.
  • No more hunting for clients or negotiating rates — let us handle the business side of things so you can focus on what you do best.
  • Choose a schedule that works best for you. It’s possible to communicate async or minimally overlap within team working hours.
  • We respect your seniority so you can expect no micromanagement or screen trackers.
  • Communicate directly with the clients. Most of them have technical backgrounds. Sounds good, yeah?
  • Most of our projects involve working in a fast-paced startup environment. We hope you like it as much as we do.

 

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of commercial experience applying AI to practical technology solutions
  • A solid understanding of Python is a must; experience with other programming languages commonly used in AI is a plus
  • Experience with Vector Databases, Pinecone or Weaviate is required
  • 2+ years of experience with LangChain is mandatory
  • 2+ years of experience with large language models (LLMs) or vLLMs is mandatory
  • 2+ years of experience with RAG or OpenAI is required

 

  • Strong technical skills: as a Senior Data Scientist, you are expected to be able to create projects from scratch and have a deep understanding of application architecture.
  • Clear and effective communication in English — advanced ability to discuss business tasks, justify decisions, and communicate issues. Good self-presentation is also essential for upcoming client calls.
  • Strong self-organizational skills — ability to work full-time remotely with no supervision.
  • Reliability — we want to trust you and expect that you won’t let us and the client down.
  • Adaptability and Flexibility — the ability to onboard the project promptly after accepting it and start delivering results quickly.

 

NOT YOUR TECH STACK?

We have a variety of projects, so if you have 4+ years of commercial software development experience and are proficient in AI Agent Architecture, AI Automation Architecture, Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, React & Python, React & Golang, Golang, React & Java, React & Ruby, Ruby, PHP & Vue, Vue & Node.js, React & .NET, Android & iOS, iOS & Swift, Flutter, Blockchain (Ethereum/Ethers.js/Wagmi/Viem/Solana), Angular & Node.js, Vue & .NET, Python & Vue, DevOps, MLOps, Data Science, Angular & PHP, Angular & .NET, Symfony & React, Symfony & Vue, Symfony & Angular, Python, Symfony & JavaScript & Next.js & TypeScript, Data Analysis, React & PHP, Data Engineering, Project Management, Product Management, QA Automation, QA Manual, Embedded Software Engineering, React Native & Node, React Native & React, React Native & Ruby, React Native & Python, WordPress, Android, Data Annotation, Angular, Python & Node, React & Node.js, Java & Spring, Svelte & Python, Svelte & Node.js, Svelte & TypeScript, Rust, Shopify & JavaScript, Vue & Nuxt, PHP & Laravel, UI/UX Design, Animation, Graphic Design, React & Node & React Native, .NET & C#, Electron, Scala, C++, Unreal Engine & C++, Python & LLM, Unity, or Machine Learning Engineering, we would be happy to connect with you and match you with a project that fits your experience.

 

We work with developers from 75+ countries across Europe, Latin America, North America (the U.S. and Canada), selected countries in Asia (Japan, Singapore, South Korea, the Philippines, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand, and Israel), Oceania (Australia, New Zealand, and Papua New Guinea), and Africa (including Morocco and South Africa).

title: Customer Operations & Writing Specialist
description:
Here at Clerky, we build software to make legal paperwork easier for startups and their attorneys. We're profitable and growing sustainably. We're the most popular way for high-growth technology startups to form, and are also used by many top-tier startups for hiring and fundraising.

 

As a Customer Operations & Writing Specialist at Clerky, you will be the voice of the company to thousands of startup founders, investors, and attorneys. These customers use Clerky to get critical legal paperwork done, often on a tight timeline. Our success is based on word-of-mouth, so we have a strong culture of providing world-class service (ask us about our satisfaction ratings!). We are rabidly customer-centric.

 

What Makes Customer Operations Different at Clerky

 

It’s a lot harder here. Helping our customers can be unusually challenging due to the nuanced and specialized nature of their questions. Doing the job well can require a lot of iterative feedback, so we're looking for someone who thinks critically about their writing and is always looking for ways to improve. Along the way, you'll also pick up a lot of knowledge about startups and startup law.

 

The challenges never stop. The level of learning and craftsmanship that goes into writing responses to our customers requires intense focus. If you’re looking for the kind of position where you can easily master all the information at the beginning and work in a way that does not require intense focus, this position will probably not be a good fit for you. On the other hand, if you love learning and constantly challenging yourself, this position could be a good fit for you.

 

There are often no right answers. We’re often not able to provide definitive answers to the questions we receive. In many cases, the best we can do is to equip our customers with the information they need to be able to figure out the right answer on their own, or to understand that it isn’t possible to figure out what the right answer is. If you prefer an environment more oriented around providing definitive answers, this position may not be a good fit for you.

Minimum Requirements

  • Genuine love for helping people

  • High emotional intelligence

  • Logical / analytical thinker

  • Exceptional written English communication skills, including the ability to write precisely and succinctly

  • Extremely detail-oriented

  • Comfort with working remotely and independently

  • Technologically savvy - you should be confident in your ability to use new software without training

  • Appreciation for giving and receiving feedback often (often several times a day)

  • Natural internal motivation to constantly strive for excellence in everything you do

How We Work

  • Clerky has been remote-first for many years, long before COVID. We’re very familiar with working remotely, and enjoy it.

  • Our team is small, so everyone's contributions matter. We work efficiently, autonomously, and with great respect for each other.

  • We work openly and collaboratively. We’re here to support you in being successful in this role. You'll work closely with other team members to ensure our customers are getting the best possible support and experience.

  • Everyone on our team works hard, and we trust team members to know what will help them be most productive. Schedules are flexible as long as there is adequate team coverage.

  • We want to help you grow, so we have a budget for books, courses, tools, or whatever other educational resources you need to be successful.

  • We offer top-of-market compensation and benefits and the opportunity to learn a lot while helping our customers through an exciting time in their lives.

Responsibilities

  • Writing thoughtful and empathetic replies to customer emails using our help desk software, Help Scout

  • Writing and maintaining help center articles, and identifying topics for new articles based on customer inquiries

  • Working with our engineering team to debug software issues our customers encounter

  • Using our software to develop and manage new ways for our customers to complete legal paperwork

  • Assisting product team by testing new features and bug fixes, and conveying customer feedback

  • Spotting trends in customer issues that other team members should be alerted to

This is a 100% remote position. You'll be able to work from home (or from anywhere else). We offer top-of-market compensation and benefits, reasonable hours, and reasonable customers. No legal experience or background is necessary or preferred.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Data Labeling Specialists
description:
Who We Are

Workada creates high-quality labeled data for advanced technology systems. Our team reviews, organizes, categorizes, evaluates, and quality-checks digital content so those systems can better understand information and perform real-world tasks.
We believe careful data work matters. Every reviewed item, categorized example, and quality-checked task helps improve how technology interprets information, follows instructions, and responds in practical settings.

About You

We're hiring detail-oriented individuals who are comfortable working on a computer and interested in careful, focused digital work. We're especially interested in:

  • People who can carefully review written information, images, documents, or other digital content
  • Strong readers and writers with good judgment
  • People who can follow detailed instructions consistently
  • Individuals who are comfortable using web-based tools and online platforms
  • People who take quality seriously and can spot mistakes or inconsistencies
  • Those who enjoy focused, independent work while contributing to a larger project
  • Strong character matters — we value integrity, reliability, curiosity, and a commitment to high-quality work



Qualifications

  • Comfortable using a computer for extended periods
  • Reliable internet connection
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to follow written guidelines and project instructions
  • Clear written communication skills
  • Basic familiarity with spreadsheets, online forms, or web-based work tools
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines
  • Prior experience in data labeling, annotation, quality review, research, writing, customer support, operations, or administrative work is helpful but not required



Compensation

Compensation is $18- $22 an hour and a max of 40 hours a week.

A Place to Do Meaningful Work

Data labeling may sound simple, but it plays an important role in improving the technology people use every day. At Workada, your work helps create the examples and feedback that make advanced systems more accurate, consistent, and useful.

We're looking for people who care about accuracy, consistency, and careful judgment. Whether you're reviewing text, categorizing information, evaluating responses, or checking data quality, your work helps improve the way technology performs.

title: Communications Manager
description:
About Lemon.io
Lemon.io is building the autopilot for hiring. 
We've replaced the slow, expensive recruiting agency with a platform that delivers vetted, responsive candidates, ready for a final interview. In days, not weeks. 
Hundreds of fast-growing companies use Lemon to build their engineering teams, from early-stage startups to enterprises. We're profitable, bootstrapped, and growing at a moment when the legacy recruiting industry is being rewritten in real time.

Here's why this role exists. We have a great story and almost no one telling it. A profitable company helping rewrite a huge industry with AI, and a voice that is still a blank canvas. You'd be the one who decides how Lemon sounds and makes the market pay attention, working directly with the founder, with the freedom that comes from being bootstrapped.

About the position
The Communications Manager will own Lemon's external voice and its distribution.
The goal: make Lemon impossible to ignore in the engineering-hiring conversation. Every day, something from Lemon should be visible where our buyers and candidates already are, until the market treats us as the category leader.
This is a senior IC role, reporting directly to the founder. You'll personally do most of the writing and build systems for distribution.
This is an intensive role. You'll be producing daily and running a content distribution engine that doesn't stop. And while we'd typically expect 4+ years of experience, we're genuinely open to less experienced candidates who can demonstrate exceptional writing and judgment.

Responsibilities:
1. Executive Communications
- Lead the creation and execution of founders' personal brand platforms
- Produce and distribute day-to-day content across founders' channels
- Support founders' earned media: podcasts, panels, op-eds, and speaking opportunities
2. Internal News Scouting and Narrative Development
- Sit in product, customer success, sales, and ops syncs to identify newsworthy stories
- Identify and shape company moments worth telling publicly
- Translate internal milestones, launches, learnings, and customer wins into external content
- Distribute content via social and traditional media.
3. Team Engagement
- Build and support an internal content program that engages employees across functions
- Equip team members to share their work publicly through ready-to-use content and templates
- Coordinate the team's participation in industry conversations across channels
4. Monitoring, Automation
- Build and maintain content and distribution workflows using AI tools
- Set up monitoring for brand mentions, press coverage, and audience growth across channels
- Track, grow and report on key communications metrics quarterly

What we're looking for:
- Native or fluent English with cultural fluency for the US tech audience
- A genuinely strong writer. 
- You've been the voice behind someone else's posts. 
- Track record telling the story of a company, a product, or a movement
- Background in technology, B2B software, talent, recruiting, dev tools, or adjacent industries.
- You’re deeply immersed in the world of independent media: Substackers, podcasters, influencers on X or LinkedIn. 
- AI is already part of how you work.
- Comfortable operating in areas of genuine uncertainty.
- Results-oriented, with a bias toward action and impact.
- Want to be part of a small, fast-paced, and impactful team.

What success looks like in the first 4 weeks:
- You've built systems to capture content from our team and product, and to manufacture news.
- You've launched an amplification program by the team and outside voices, so every message travels.
- A repurposing workflow exists: one idea becomes a post, a thread, a clip, a newsletter line, without starting over each time.
- You've identified the 3 to 5 narratives that everyone will repeat.
- You've identified a few internal voices and enabled them to post regularly, with systems that feed them content ideas.
- By week 4, the founder's social posts go out 4 to 5 times a week.
- Baseline metrics captured, so growth is measurable from a known starting point.
Application Process

To apply, send us:
- Three writing samples that show range. At least one should be in a voice that isn't yours: something you ghost-wrote for an executive, a founder, or another public-facing operator.  
- A short note (200 words or fewer) telling us why this role and what you'd want to ship in your first 90 days. The point isn't to summarize your resume. It's to give us a sense of how you think and what you'd actually do.

What to expect:
- Application review within 7 days
- 45-minute call with the hiring team
- Paid trial project (up to 10 hours)
- Final 60-minute conversation with the founder
- Reference checks and offer

We aim to move from application to offer within 3-4 weeks.

title: Client Success Coach (CSM)
description:
We’re looking for a full-time Client Success Coach to join our fast-growing team at Richard Yu’s online education company. Our mission is simple: help everyday people launch impactful online digital arbitrage businesses that transform lives—starting with their own.

If you’re someone who loves mentorship, thrives in a high-performance environment, and wants to make a real difference in people’s lives, keep reading.

About Us:
Richard Yu is an online business coach with:

  • 100K+ subscribers on YouTube → youtube.com/richardyu1
  • A growing personal brand on Instagram → instagram.com/richardyuzee

Our company is fast-paced, and rooted in service. We’re building a world-class education platform to help people turn their knowledge into income through coaching and consulting.

About The Role:
This is a remote, full-time position. You must be available during 8AM–5PM EST, Monday to Friday. On average, you’ll work up to 9 hours per day, and some days will require a little more effort of 10 hours.

You must currently live in North America, Europe, or South Africa, and speak fluent, accent-neutral English. Clear communication is non-negotiable, we’re in the coaching business.



Requirements

Here are the requirements:

  • You must be able to commit full time hours (Our office hours are 9 AM - 6 PM EST, though if you are different time zones we're super open minded) 
  • You will be conducting new onboarding calls daily to welcome in new students.
  • You will be conducting check in coaching calls daily, to hold accountable, motivate, and inspire students inside the program (must be comfortable jumping on 1:1 Zoom calls or recording Loom videos as needed.
  • You will be messaging clients on a daily basis, in order to hold them accountable to their plan of execution towards their goals and moderating the community.
  • Weekly group coaching calls answering client questions
  • Must have strong communication/interpersonal skills so we can put you in front of our clients and you can confidently answer their questions and guide their decisions
  • Help innovate our products by creating and producing new video trainings/worksheets to deliver a world-class experience.
  • Taking renewal / upgrade calls with clients and enrolling them into our backend coaching programs.
  • Should be proficient or at least knowledgeable about our tech stack (Loom, ActiveCampaign, Slack, Zapier, Calendly, GSuite, CRM, etc.) - you should be familiar with the above tools, or have a willingness to learn these VERY quickly if hired.
  • Your role will constantly be changing. A big part of this job is to stay on your toes, always ready for action and change.
  • You will be responsible for daily reporting on multiple communication channels (Slack, text message, spreadsheets, etc.,) and so a high attention to detail and compliance with standard operating procedures is essential.
  • You must have a high attention to detail and understand systems/processes so you are able to innovate new, more efficient SOPs (processes) to ensure our Fulfillment Team hits their KPIs

WHO THIS IS FOR:

  • A coach or mentor at heart—you love helping people
  • Clear, professional communicator (spoken and written English)
  • Experienced with organic marketing on Instagram/Facebook/TikTok (creating reels, organic posts, to generate organic leads)
  • Sales background
  • Able to handle fast-paced environments, multiple clients, and changing priorities
  • Willing to grow with us long-term (3+ years)—this isn’t a side hustle
  • Open to feedback and constructive coaching (we’ll train you, but we expect growth)
  • Comfortable with tools like Loom, Calendly, Slack, GSuite, CRMs, etc—or willing to learn fast

WHO THIS IS NOT FOR:

  • You have another full-time job or multiple freelance clients
  • You struggle with structure, deadlines, or fast execution
  • You dislike being challenged to improve daily



Benefits

Expected Earnings (Rev share on book of business): $10,000–$15,000+ USD/month (depending on experience)

Commission opportunities: % on referrals, upgrades, renewals, and pending payment collections.

title: Sales Assistant
description:
This role may require you to be on site at times - please check with the employer first.

 

 Job Title: Sales Assistant

 

 Company: Endureed

 

 Location: Lake City, FL / Remote eligible

 

 Reports to: VP of Global Sales

 

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

 

 

The Sales Assistant is the operational backbone of the US sales team. You'll provide hands-on administrative, coordination, and customer support to the VP of Global Sales — keeping the department running smoothly, accurately, and on time across residential and Strategic Partner (SP) channels.

 

 

 

This isn't a role for someone who wants to wing it, work independently without structure, or stay at arm's length from the details. It's a role for someone who finds real satisfaction in making sure nothing falls through the cracks someone who takes pride in accuracy, follows through without being asked twice, and genuinely enjoys being the person others can count on.

 

 

 

If you're the kind of person who gets energized by creating order, supporting a team, and doing the unglamorous-but-critical work that makes everything else possible keep reading.

 

 

 

✓  You'll thrive here if you...

 

•       Get genuine satisfaction from organizing, tracking, and keeping things accurate

 

•       Take ownership of tasks and follow through without being reminded

 

•       Prefer a defined role with clear expectations over open-ended autonomy

 

•       Are naturally calm, steady, and don't rattle easily when things get busy

 

•       Build trust by being dependable, not by being loud

 

•       Take pride in serving others and helping your team look good

 

•       Are bilingual in English and Spanish and comfortable using both professionally

 

•       Thrive in a structured, process-driven environment with consistent routines

 

✗  This role is NOT for you if you...

 

•       Need to be the center of attention or get credit to feel motivated

 

•       Prefer creating your own process over following an established one

 

•       Dislike repetitive tasks or detailed administrative work

 

•       Get bored or frustrated when you're not driving strategy or making big decisions

 

•       Struggle to stay organized when managing multiple people's priorities at once

 

•       Want flexibility to define your own schedule or work style without check-ins

 

•       Move fast and loose, accuracy and follow-through aren't your strong suits

 

•       Are looking for a stepping stone to a sales rep role as fast as possible

 

 

 

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 

Day-to-day, you will:

 

•       Provide administrative support to the VP of Global Sales, calendar management, scheduling, travel coordination, and communications

 

•       Prepare and update sales reports, presentations, and customer-facing materials for residential and SP accounts

 

•       Own CRM data entry, lead tracking, and pipeline management, data must be accurate and current at all times

 

•       Coordinate between the sales team and the SP network, including onboarding new partners and managing ongoing communication

 

•       Track SP territory coverage and ensure Basics product line distribution aligns with current SP network policies

 

•       Conduct market and competitor research to support US sales strategy

 

•       Help organize sales campaigns, trade shows, events, and client meetings, logistics, materials, follow-up

 

•       Ensure timely document and information flow between the sales team, operations, and other departments

 

•       Support order processing and client onboarding across residential and SP channels

 

 

WHAT YOU BRING

 

•       Bilingual — English and Spanish required, written and spoken (non-negotiable)

 

•       2+ years in a sales support, coordinator, or administrative role, you've done this before and you're good at it

 

•       CRM experience required; NetSuite or similar ERP a strong plus

 

•       Proficiency with Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace, especially Excel/Sheets and PowerPoint/Slides

 

•       Exceptional organizational skills, you manage multiple moving pieces without losing track of any of them

 

•       High attention to detail, errors bother you before anyone else catches them

 

•       Calm, professional communication style, written and verbal

 

 

•       Experience in building materials, construction, or a product-based industry is a plus, not a requirement

 

 

To apply, please complete our Culture Index survey before submitting your application:

https://go.cultureindex.com/p/dmxXuQJk6Y4WKDaTvN

Applications without a completed survey will not be considered.

  1. Send an email to careers@endureed.com with the subject line: "Sales Assistant Application, First and Last Name" (replace with your name)

title: Technical Recruiter 2026 New Graduate
description:
About Radiant

Radiant is an El Segundo, CA-based startup building the worldâs first mass-produced, portable nuclear microreactors. The companyâs first reactor, Kaleidos, is a 1-megawatt, fail-safe microreactor that can be transported anywhere power is needed and run for up to 5 years without refueling. Portable nuclear power with rapid-deploy capability can replace similar-sized diesel generators and provide critical asset support for hospitals, data centers, remote sites, and military bases. Radiantâs unique, practical approach to nuclear development leverages modern software engineering to rapidly deliver safe, factory-built microreactors that use existing, well-qualified materials. Founded in 2020, Radiant is on track to test its first reactor at the Idaho National Laboratory this summer, with initial customer deliveries beginning in 2028.

About the Role

Radiant is seeking a driven recent grad to join our talent team and help build the engineering teams behind Kaleidos, our portable, mass-producible nuclear microreactor targeting commercial deployment in 2028. This is a role for someone who wants to start a career in recruitment, work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with real ownership and influence, build a deep tech career, and learn about several technical domains like nuclear, hardware, electrical, software, and more. You'll get close mentorship from recruiters and sourcers who've built teams before, regular visibility with executives, own requisitions, and find top talent for engineering leaders and their teams.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Run your own reqs from open to close, building the pipeline, screening candidates, coordinating interviews, and getting offers signed.

  • Find niche talent markets for specialized engineering roles in places like GitHub repos, arXiv papers, technical mailing lists, tech foundation communities, conference speaker rosters, and academic programs.

  • Create talent market reports based on research you drive to help make better-informed recruiting strategies.

  • Coordinate interviews and help facilitate hiring team debriefs to keep decisions moving quickly.

  • Sit in on offer conversations with senior recruiters and learn how strategy and closing work in practice.

  • Help shape how Radiant recruits; the processes, tools, and 3rd party platforms you help build and adopt now become the foundation the team scales on.

  • Get hands-on exposure to hiring across multiple technical functions: electrical, mechanical, software, and more.

Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university.

  • 0â2 years of experience in recruiting, sales, sourcing, or coordination, or you've picked it up on your own and can point to something that proves it.

  • Something outside the classroom that shows real team influence, a club you led, student government, a project you built, a sport you competed in, or work you volunteered for.

  • A genuine pull toward hardware, nuclear, physics, or AI/ML; you don't need an engineering background, just real curiosity.

  • A bias toward action: you move quickly, problem-solve on the fly, and know when to raise your hand for help.

  • You're able to hold a genuine conversation with technical candidates, curious enough to ask good questions, and honest enough to admit when something's outside your depth.

Desired Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in a STEM-related major is a plus.

  • Any prior exposure to hardware, software, engineering, or tech recruiting, even informally.

  • Comfort picking up new tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS, sourcing, LLM platforms, even without direct prior experience.

Additional Requirements:

  • Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as necessary to accomplish our mission.

  • Must work 100% onsite at El Segundo HQ.

Benefits and Perks

  • Stock: Substantial incentive stock plan for all full-time employees.

  • Medical: 100% up to base silver level plan for employee + 50% dependents, offers up to Platinum plans.

  • One Medical: Sponsored memberships for employees and their dependents.

  • Vision: 100% top tier plan coverage + 50% for dependents.

  • Dental: 100% top tier plan coverage, orthodontia extra, 50% for dependents.

  • Voluntary life, accident, hospital, critical illness, commuter and FSA/HSA are offered as employee contributed benefits.

  • 8-weeks of paid parental leave for all parents. Additional paid pregnancy leave for CA employees.

  • Daily catered lunch. Free snacks and drinks.

  • Flexible PTO policy. Remote workday allocation.

  • Company and team-bonding events, happy hours and in-person camaraderie.

  • Beautiful El Segundo headquarters close to the Pacific Ocean.

Total Compensation and Benefits
Radiant compensates people for impact and invests in those who continue to raise the bar. Radiantâs new hire compensation package includes base salary, substantial equity grants, and comprehensive health benefits. Total compensation and level are determined through a rigorous evaluation of interview performance, experience, education, and qualifications, and are designed to support continued growth as scope, responsibility, and impact expand at Radiant.

The best of todayâs advanced reactor builders donât wait for job postings. They join the winning team. If thatâs you, contact us directly for immediate opportunities: recruiting@radiantnuclear.com.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

This position involves access to technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicantâs capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Executive Assistant / Operations Coordinator (Remote)

Location

Remote

Employment Type

Contract (with potential to transition to full-time)

Compensation

USD $500â$1,200 per month, depending on experience, skills, availability, and location.

About Us

We are a venture capital firm backing ambitious founders building the next generation of technology companies. We work closely with entrepreneurs from the earliest stages, helping them grow through capital, strategic guidance, and access to our network.

We're looking for a highly organized, proactive Executive Assistant / Operations Coordinator to support our leadership team and keep day-to-day operations running smoothly.

What You'll Do

  • Manage executive calendars, scheduling, and meeting coordination across multiple time zones.
  • Organize investor, founder, and partner meetings.
  • Prepare agendas, take meeting notes, and follow up on action items.
  • Coordinate travel, accommodations, and itineraries when required.
  • Support internal operations, documentation, and process improvements.
  • Maintain organized records, files, and internal knowledge bases.
  • Assist with preparing presentations, reports, and spreadsheets.
  • Coordinate virtual events, webinars, and team meetings.
  • Liaise with founders, investors, vendors, and external partners professionally.
  • Handle confidential information with discretion.
  • Provide general administrative support to the investment and operations teams.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Operations Coordinator, Administrative Assistant, or similar role.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication in English.
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Proactive mindset with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and professionalism.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Calendar, Drive), Microsoft Office, Zoom, Slack, and Notion or similar productivity tools.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working at a startup, venture capital, private equity, or technology company.
  • Familiarity with CRM tools such as HubSpot or Affinity.
  • Experience coordinating events or investor communications.
  • Basic project management experience.
  • Experience supporting multiple executives.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work.
  • Flexible working hours with overlap during core business hours.
  • Opportunity to work closely with founders, investors, and high-growth startups.
  • High ownership and autonomy.
  • Collaborative, fast-paced environment with opportunities to learn and grow.

title: No
description:
(And how to say it. )

No to free pitching. So the ad industry finally seems to be finding a singular voice on calling out unhealthy business practice.

The message is clear. Learn how to say, âNoâ, or raise your hand to being a (worn out) door mat. For too long weâve given, âYes I canâ gold star status. So letâs hear it for, âNo, not for meâ. And relish every word.

But why is it so damn difficult to say?

What scares us the most about ânopeâ is that we perceive it to somehow diminish us, make us less âgoodâ. Less likeable.

Truth is itâs where respect starts.

So much of this people-pleasing stuff goes back to when were children. It came gilded as manners - being good and polite. But boy was it loaded. And we knew it.

So now when every fibre of our being is screaming, âNo!â thereâs a mute child within, worried about doing the wrong thing.

Bringing this back to creative basecamp. Iâm sure you can think of a million and one examples of when ânoâ is the perfectly right thing to say. Can you stay and work up a few more examples? Can you work the weekend? Can you give me some ideas (that I will then not credit you for)? Can you knock me up a quick logo /speed read my script (again)? Cut to that feeling when you show up or hand over. Youâve been âhadâ AGAIN. You missed out on doing something you really wanted to do. You denied yourself.

You know what I hate the most? Rather than say, âNoâ, we fall back on those pathetic well-worn excuses. You know the ones. Who is fooling who? And the guilt, the need for a fantastic memory. All because. And even when weâve made a pact with ourselves to say, âNoâ, we still get caught off guard. Why does a perfectly reasonable, âNoâ, pop out as a, âYesâ?

Iâll tell you why. We donât practise saying, âNoâ enough. Unlike all our positive affirmations, we just donât flex the, âNoâ muscle in a way thatâs easy to voice when we need it.

âNoâ needs a brand refresh.

ENTER THE NEW NO. A POSITIVE NEGATIVE (with added feel good factor).

Here Are a Few To Try For Size

(NB. Ditch the old âsorryâ appendage. There is nothing to be sorry for. End of.)

  • Iâd love to but Iâm already committed toâ¦
  • Thank you for thinking of me for x , but I like to give things 100% and I just donât have the time to give x the attention it deserves.
  • Itâs a busy month, let me check my diary when I get back. (Buy time.)
  • I canât do that date, but does x work for you? (Buy control.)
  • Itâs not something that feels right for me, but I could put you in touch with x (Helpful.)
  • I can do it, but I only have an hour. (Compromise.)

Write your own, pop them on your phone. Never get caught without a, âNoâ in your back pocket again.

Oh and hereâs a nice quoteâ¦

âStanding up for yourself and saying no doesnât make you argumentative, sharing your feelings doesnât make you oversensitive and saying no doesnât make you uncaring or selfish. If someone wonât respect your feelings, needs and boundaries, the problem isnât you; its them.â Lori Deschene.

If anything here resonates with you, please share. Iâm not saying anything radical, but sometimes a reminder of the basic stuff is all we need to make a big difference.

title: Widen the circle
description:
I coach a lot of creative professionals who come to me at real crossroads in their careers - some have a menu of choices they are trying to decide from, or for some, itâs, âhelp me to do anything other than what I am doing right now!â

Regardless of which curated coaching path we end up travelling along, the process starts with a deep dive into the unconscious mind and ends up with a lateral shift and a conversation with someone you never imagined. (I say ends, but thatâs really the start).

My point is this, we are all capable of polishing a CV, calling a recruiter or going to a network event but real finds are made when you step outside your networks and allow yourself to get curious.

Rather than think, who do I know, think who donât I know? Time and time again people tell me I want to do X but I donât know anyone, or they give up when a quick-fire email to friends, or friends of friends yields nothing. SLOW DOWN. Do your detective work. Challenge yourself to think outside your normal circle and widen your contact strategy. Get comfortable with using LinkedIn, it's still, in my opinion, the best platform for seeking out professionals who share your interests and voice interesting opinions. See what causes they support, and what events they pop up at. There will be someone doing something very similar to what youâd like to try somewhere in the world. 9/10 times those people are very generous with their time IF they sense a real connection and passion. And this is the point, your standard cover note and a CV will probably not be enough. Neither is the sycophantic, Iâve been a great fan approach.

Take time to do your research. What nugget of info can you share with them that shows a deeper level of interest or knowledge? Equally, as much as you want to speak to the CEO, are they the right person? A great piece of advice someone once gave to me was, to aim your intro to the middle ranks of a company. Someone within reach of the decision-makers, but not so overwhelmed with the really big stuff that they canât spare you the time. The bonus of this approach is that they, as your champion, can feel they are making a difference, and through your energy and enthusiasm, look good too.

It's easy to say donât give up, but please donât. Trust the process. Be strict about getting emails off, but equally, build a realistic framework for a reply. Nothing personal but the likelihood is, that you are at the bottom of the recipients' priorities. I like to work to a 2-week rule - no reply after 2 weeks., knock again. Keep adapting the tempo and the timing. Keep challenging yourself to think laterally about how to make contact and widen the circle of possible contact points. Creativity is your tool. Persistence is the means.

Frame your search as one of curiosity and discovery, because whilst it might not beat precisely to your âget me outta hereâ clock, it will protect you from search fatigue - the death toll for all career shifts. Keep reflecting on the evidence, If all your research is leading to the insight that you need to invest in new skills, donât just plough on, waiting to hear what you think you want to hear. Constantly re-evaluate your timeframe and reshape what you do. Be realistic. I donât mean that in the, âwho do you think you areâ sense, but the truth is, you only have so much time in a day.

Build time for research, volunteering, spec briefs etc, but keep a beady on what it is costing you - financially and time-wise. Time and money are grim reapers in the career move cast. Can you combine new learning with what you are doing right now? Constantly check your motivation levels and as Bill âDesign Your Lifeâ Burnett says, âGet good at feeling luckyâ. Thereâs evidence that people with this attitude are more likely to be tuned into the kind of interesting opportunities on the periphery of our vision. AKA, be less blinkered and try stuff.

And last but not least, get used to the idea that gut instinct is a real and valuable compass. Because it just is.

title: Non Executive Director
description:
Help Shape the Future of a Purpose-Driven Member Fund

The Ambulance Provident Fund (APF) is seeking an independent, volunteer Non-Executive Director to join its Board and contribute to the next chapter of the Fund's growth and sustainability.


Since 1981, APF has provided financial peace of mind to its members and their families by ensuring affordable, accessible and immediate financial assistance to nominated beneficiaries upon the death of a member. APF's vision is to be a national fund providing financial peace of mind for members' beneficiaries, supported by a strong commitment to fairness, transparency, accountability, integrity and compassion.


Following a recent Board Strategy Workshop and Board Skills and Capability Assessment, APF has adopted an ambitious strategic agenda for 2026â2029 focused on:

  • Contemporary governance and organisational resilience.
  • Sustainable financial performance and investment stewardship.
  • Enhanced member and stakeholder engagement.
  • Sustainable membership growth and national expansion opportunities.

 As part of its succession planning and ongoing Board renewal, APF is seeking an independent Director who can complement the existing Board and bring critical skills, experience and strategic insight to support the achievement of these objectives.


About the Opportunity

This is a volunteer Board position providing strategic oversight, governance and stewardship of the Fund. Directors work collaboratively to ensure APF remains financially sustainable, well-governed and responsive to the needs of current and future members.


Desired Skills and Experience

The Board is particularly interested in candidates with demonstrated experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • Financial management, investment oversight or treasury management.
  • Actuarial, insurance, superannuation or mutual fund experience.
  • Strategic growth, business development or member-based organisations.
  • Board experience.

Candidates with experience in not-for-profit, member-based, emergency services, healthcare or community-focused organisations will be highly regarded.


Personal Attributes

The successful applicant will demonstrate:

  • Strong strategic thinking and sound judgement.
  • High standards of integrity and ethical leadership.
  • A collaborative and respectful approach.
  • A commitment to good governance and accountability.

The Board meets approximately six times throughout the year in a combination of face to face and online formats, with Directors also participating in strategic planning sessions, committee work and other governance activities as required.


How to Apply

Applicants should provide:

  • A current curriculum vitae; and
  • A brief covering letter outlining their interest in the role and the skills and experience they would bring to the APF Board.

Join us in supporting a trusted organisation dedicated to providing financial peace of mind to members and their families. Together, we can help shape APF's future and extend its impact for generations to come.


Applications

To apply, please send your application (cover letter and resume) to secretary@ambprov.org.au  by COB Wednesday 5 August 2026.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
About Haven Safety:
Haven is transforming how organizations learn from workplace incidents.

Built in partnership with The AES Corporation and backed by AI Fund, Haven applies purpose-built AI to incident investigations, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and organizational learning. Our platform helps utilities, energy companies, construction firms, and other high-risk industries dramatically reduce investigation effort while improving investigation quality and organizational learning.

We're an early-stage company with enterprise customers, global ambitions, and an experienced leadership team. We're looking for exceptional salespeople who enjoy building a category rather than simply selling software.

The Opportunity:
We are seeking an experienced Enterprise Account Executive with a successful track record selling enterprise EHS software. You will own opportunities from discovery through executive alignment, proof of value, commercial negotiation, and close. You will engage Fortune 1000 executives across Safety, Operations, IT, Risk, and Procurement and help customers rethink how work gets done through AI.

\n


Responsibilities Include:
  • Own enterprise sales opportunities from qualification through close.
  • Develop executive relationships across Safety, Operations, IT, Risk, and Procurement.
  • Lead consultative discovery and business value discussions.
  • Demonstrate Haven's platform and ROI.
  • Coordinate pilots and proof-of-value engagements.
  • Build business cases and ROI models.
  • Navigate enterprise procurement, security, and legal reviews.
  • Partner with Customer Success during implementation.
  • Represent Haven at industry events.
  • Consistently exceed revenue targets.


What Success Looks Like:

Within your first year you will close multiple enterprise customers, become a trusted advisor to senior EHS leaders, contribute to Haven's go-to-market strategy, and help establish Haven as the leader in AI-powered industrial safety.


Required Experience Includes:
  • 7+ years of enterprise B2B software sales.
  • Success selling into Fortune 1000 organizations.
  • Experience leading complex multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles.
  • Consistent history of exceeding quota.
  • Experience building executive relationships with EHS, Operations, Risk, or Operational Excellence leaders.
  • Strong consultative selling skills.
  • Excellent executive communication and presentation skills.
  • Experience navigating procurement, security, and legal reviews.


Nice to Haves Include:

title: Brand Designer
description:
About Co-Star

Someone downloads CoâStar every 5 seconds.

In the five years since we launched, 25% of young people 18-25 in the US have downloaded the app. Big Sean has rapped about us, Ariana Grande & Kevin Durant post screenshots to their IGs, and we've been App of the Day twice. We've been featured in the New York Times three times, this year on the cover of NYT Style. We have a global following, in 193 countries â missing just North Korea and Eritrea.

We don't pay for marketing â we designed the app to go viral, and it did.

Astrology has been popular for 4,000 years.

Astrology is a tool for speaking about yourself, about who you are, what you're experiencing, and how you relate to other people â in other words, a language for the things that really matter. It's a structured system, based on the physical locations of the planets in the sky, developed over millennia 4,000 years of practice.

Everyone has memories of reading a horoscope in the newspaper. You know your sign the same way you know the name of the street you grew up on. An average of 43% of Americans have believed in astrology since the 1970s.

We're merging the resonance of the humanities with the precision of technology.

Co-Star uses real-time NASA data and AI to bring this practice to the modern age. Every day, CoâStar generates millions of hyper-personalized horoscopes â a scale never previously possible. Every word of it is based on each person's unique astrology: where the stars physically were when they were born and where those same stars are now. CoâStar combines the art of ancient practice with cutting-edge artificial intelligence, creating the first synthetic text to be called "wildly beautiful."

We're a small, experienced team.

Co-Star is a team of 30, with experience in big tech (Amazon, Google, Snapchat), entertainment (Frank Ocean, Adult Swim), and academia (Harvard, Stanford, NYU, Columbia).

About The Brand Designer Role

We're looking for a talented visual designer to shape how Co-Star shows up outside of the app, in the broader world. We are looking for someone with a fresh, opinionated, and high-quality design foundation who can create work that feels distinct, not what's now but what's next.

You'll partner closely with the leadership on campaigns and visual storytelling across earned and owned channels. This is a freelance engagement with potential for a long-term partnership as the work (and team) grows.

What you'll do

  • Design campaign visuals: ads, social, launches â from concept through finished assets
  • Bring editorial design sensibility to our owned channels: email/welcome series, blog, campaign imagery
  • Develop visual systems that are expressive rather than corporate
  • Partner with marketing on what earned and owned should look and feel like
  • Collaborate async with a small, fast-moving team

You might be a fit if

  • You're a senior IC â roughly 5â8 years in â with a portfolio of expressive, culturally fluent graphic design: editorial, campaigns, identities across print and digital
  • Typography and composition are your first language
  • You can direct as well as execute: you've shaped campaigns, not just produced assets for them
  • You're plugged into visual culture across art, fashion, publishing, music, and the internet
  • You work well remotely and independently

Nice to have

  • Editorial/publication experience (print or digital magazines)
  • Motion or illustration
  • You already make things with generative tools

Logistics

  • Freelance/contract, part-time to start, with room to grow
  • Fully remote, anywhere. No travel required (though you're always welcome in NYC)

To apply

Send your portfolio. We care about taste, range, and point of view.

title: VP of Strategic Partnerships & Growth
description:
About HealthCorps

HealthCorps is a national non-profit committed to improving lives by addressing health challenges in communities through innovative programming in education, leadership, and service learning. We empower teens to become change agents within their families, schools, and neighborhoods. Our program is grounded in the understanding that limited access to health education can lead to a lifetime of social, emotional, and physical challenges.

The Opportunity

HealthCorps is launching a new Growth & Strategic Partnerships Division, and the VP of Strategic Partnerships & Growth will be its architect, engine, and external face. You'll hold a broad, high-impact portfolio: leading HealthCorps' national funder and strategic partnerships, driving development, grant management, and fundraising, shaping our brand and marketing, and growing our alumni, community, and hub partnership work. You won't do it alone. A national team, along with program managers across our hubs, will help you build and execute this vision.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you will hold your own portfolio of partnerships, work closely with leadership to develop and execute strategies that meet HealthCorps' revenue and growth goals, and represent HealthCorps externally at donor meetings, funder convenings, and sector events. This is an ideal role for a mission-aligned leader who can prospect a health system executive and coach a marketing manager in the same week, someone energized by both the hunt and the build.

For-profit and private sector backgrounds are strongly welcomed. If you have driven revenue, built partnerships, and told a compelling brand story, in any sector, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Do

External Relationship Strategy, Cultivation & Maintenance (30%)

  • Serve as a key external relationship officer alongside the CEO, cultivating and stewarding relationships across health systems, corporate sponsors, school districts, foundations, and community organizations
  • Design and lead a comprehensive partnership strategy spanning grant, sponsor, and programmatic relationships that aligns funder priorities with organizational growth goals
  • Build and manage a robust pipeline of new and emerging partnership opportunities, cultivating prospects from first touch through qualification
  • Steward existing partners to deepen loyalty, increase lifetime value, and drive renewals and upgrades
  • Track funding trends and shifting funder priorities to position HealthCorps ahead of major market shifts

Pitching, Proposals & Partner Stewardship (25%)

  • Own the full partnership sales cycle for mid-tier and emerging opportunities, from first outreach through close and activation
  • Develop pitches, proposals, and grant applications that translate HealthCorps' outcomes data into a compelling, fundable case for support
  • Partner with the CEO and leadership to identify, solicit, and close transformational sponsorships for the major annual fundraiser and national and hub-level programming
  • Demonstrate ongoing value to existing partners through exceptional stewardship that keeps them connected to our mission and measurable impact

Brand Strategy & Voice (20%)

  • Set strategic tone and direction for the HealthCorps brand across all external-facing channels and oversee the Marketing Manager in executing it across social media, website, newsletters, and press
  • Lead the design and execution of a brand and communications strategy that builds awareness and trust across funders, partners, and the broader public
  • Partner with program teams to translate research-validated impact data and stories into compelling, consistent external narratives
  • Develop partner-facing collateral â partnership decks, impact reports, and stakeholder communications â that reflect the quality of the organization
  • Represent HealthCorps at conferences, sector events, and media opportunities alongside the CEO and program leaders

Hub, Community & Alumni Partnerships (15%)

  • Build local advisory committees that connect HealthCorps to local civic, education, and philanthropic leaders, in partnership with the Alumni & Community Manager and Program Directors
  • Strengthen HealthCorps' presence in each market by partnering with local teams to plan events, cultivate partnerships, and raise the organization's visibility
  • Cultivate and engage HealthCorps' alumni as a strategic community, building a strong, active network and connecting alumni to advisory roles, volunteer opportunities, and local partnerships that extend our reach

Division Leadership & Team Management (10%)

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team: Senior Manager of Development, Marketing Manager, Director of Events (part-time), and Alumni & Community Manager
  • Serve as a player-coach who models the work while developing others, holding your own partnership portfolio while coaching the team toward revenue and relationship goals
  • Establish and monitor division KPIs across pipeline, revenue, and brand performance, reporting to the CEO and Board to ensure measurable ROI
  • Manage the division budget and contribute to organization-wide strategic planning as a member of the leadership team

Who You Are

You are a relationship-builder, a closer, and a brand thinker. The ideal candidate brings:

  • 7+years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, sales, or revenue-generating roles, with a demonstrated track record of closing and stewarding high-value relationships. Nonprofit, for-profit, and private sector backgrounds are all strongly welcomed
  • Experience holding your own portfolio while leading and developing a team; you are a player-coach who can model the work and develop others simultaneously
  • Proven pitching and presentation skills; you are comfortable in a boardroom, at a funder meeting, and in a pitch meeting, and you know how to read a room and close
  • Experience setting brand direction and overseeing marketing or communications functions, with the ability to translate complex program outcomes into compelling external narratives
  • Strong written communication skills: from partner proposals to grant narratives to impact reports, your writing moves people to act
  • Familiarity with health systems, corporate social responsibility, education, or youth-serving sectors; experience working with health systems or school districts is a strong plus
  • Comfort building and operating in an entrepreneurial, fast-growth environment where you may be creating systems and structures from scratch
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms and a data-driven approach to pipeline management and relationship tracking. And a data-driven approach to pipeline management and relationship tracking
  • A genuine belief in the power of near-peer mentorship and a passion for health equity and youth development

Requirements

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor's degree in business, public health, communications, marketing, or a related field.

  • 7+ years of relevant professional experience in business development, strategic partnerships, sales, or revenue leadership in any sector.
  • Experience managing direct reports and leading cross-functional teams
  • Demonstrated success closing and growing partnerships, accounts, or revenue relationships and managing a portfolio of accounts
  • Travel to HealthCorps hubs, partner sites, and sector events will be required

Preferred

  • Experience in healthcare, health systems, corporate social responsibility, or youth-serving organizations, nonprofit or for-profit
  • Track record of building revenue through client, sponsor, or partner relationships; experience with philanthropic fundraising is a plus but not required
  • Experience building advisory boards, local steering committees, or community engagement structures
  • Experience translating a commercial sales or business development skillset into a mission-driven environment
  • Master's degree or equivalent advanced training

Compensation & Benefits

This is a full time, exempt position, and you will be offered a comprehensive benefits package. Yearly compensation for the role depends on a number of factors, including candidates' qualifications, skills, competencies, experience, and location.

Because we operate across multiple states, compensation is aligned with applicable federal, state, and local requirements, including salary thresholds where applicable. Slight preference given to the candidate that live in one of our hub areas: Pittsburgh, PA, Philadelphia, PA, Cleveland, OH, Oklahoma City, OK, South Florida (Palm Beach/Miami), Houston, TX and Phoenix, AZ.

At HealthCorps, we believe our team members are our greatest asset. That's why full-time employees enjoy comprehensive benefits packages designed to support your health, financial security, and overall, well-being. Our offerings include

  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) to relax, recharge, and take care of what matters most
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance to keep you and your family healthy
  • Life Insurance coverage for added piece of mind
  • A 401(k) with company match to help you plan for the future
  • Additional ancillary benefits tailored to fit your lifestyle and needs

Plus, HealthCorps proudly recognizes and observes most federal holidays, giving you even more opportunities to rest and connect outside of work.

HealthCorps, Inc. Is an Equal Opportunity Employer. HealthCorps provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics, and in compliance with all state and federal law requirements.

HealthCorps, Inc. Complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

HealthCorps, Inc. Reserves the right to conduct background investigations and/or reference checks on all its potential employees. Your job offer is contingent upon a clearance of a background investigation and/or reference check.

Note: HealthCorps reserves the right to assign additional duties, as needed. All HealthCorps employees are encouraged to be flexible and responsive to changes in scope of duties.

title: Safety Data Analyst
description:
About SkyWest

With over 16,000 aviation professionals operating thousands of daily flights, SkyWest Airlines connects millions of passengers each month to hundreds of destinations across North America. SkyWest operates in partnership with Delta Air Lines, United Airlines, American Airlines, and Alaska Airlines and has a fleet of nearly 450 aircraft. Headquartered in St. George, Utah, SkyWest's industry-leading workforce and excellent leadership team have consistently generated solid operational and economic performance, setting the standard for excellence in the regional industry.

SkyWest employees enjoy a distinctive and unmatched culture of teamwork, respect, quality, and professionalism, along with world-class benefits such as a 401(k) match, Performance Rewards, health care, retirement, and discounted travel worldwide.

Primary Job Duties

  • Analyze, compile, and report safety data to support all SkyWest safety programs.
  • Collect, analyze, and report safety assurance data from multiple safety data sources.
  • Identify, monitor, and communicate safety performance trends and emerging risks.
  • Track, maintain, and report key performance indicators (KPIs) for the Safety Department, including Flight Severity Index (FSI) events.
  • Present data analysis findings in safety meetings, investigations, and Safety Risk Assessments (SRAs).
  • Provide safety data reports and analysis for:
  • Partner safety metric reporting
  • Internal and external safety meetings
  • Pattern and trend analysis for Department Safety Managers and Safety Committees
  • Ad hoc reporting supporting investigations and proactive risk assessments
  • Maintain process measurement data and performance metrics for Safety Managers.
  • Create, update, and maintain Tableau dashboards and other reporting tools to support safety initiatives.
  • Support data-driven decision-making through proactive analysis of safety risks and operational trends.
  • Recognize and report hazards in the work environment through established safety reporting programs.
  • Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and timely delivery of safety data and reports.

Compensation: The salary range for this position is $37,000-$52,000 per year. Initial offers will be based on a combination of relevant work experience, education, certifications, and formal training.

Minimum Requirements

  • Qualified through education, training, experience, and expertise to perform data analysis functions.
  • Formal education in data analytics, statistics, quantitative methods, data collection, data interpretation, and analytical techniques; and/or a professional data analyst certification.
  • Two years of experience as a Data Analyst or in a related analytical role.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex data findings to leadership and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize competing deadlines.
  • Highly proficient in Microsoft Excel and experienced with the Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Proficiency in Tableau, including dashboard development and maintenance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with aviation safety assurance programs, such as ASAP, FOQA, and LOSA.
  • Experience with Excellence through Quality (EtQ) Reliance software.
  • Experience working within an Aviation Safety Management System (SMS).
  • Knowledge of Federal Aviation Regulations (FARs) and company policies and procedures.
  • Experience analyzing operational, safety, or risk-management data.
  • Experience collecting, analyzing, and interpreting large datasets to identify trends, risks, and performance indicators.

Physical And Other Requirements

  • Open to remote work or based in SGU or SLC.
  • Ability to sit for extended periods while working at a computer.
  • Ability to travel occasionally as required.
  • This is not a Department of Transportation safety-sensitive position.

Please complete the online application. Top candidates will be contacted for an interview

title: Paralegal
description:
Why join Giga

  • The Pace: We're building at a speed most companies talk about but never actually operate at. If you've been bored somewhere else, you won't be here.
  • The Impact: Every person at Giga touches the work that matters. No layers, no waiting for approval chains. You'll see your fingerprints on what we ship.
  • The Team: A team of operators defining the future of AI infrastructure. We recruit A-players from the most innovative companies in the world, and they choose Giga because the work here means more.
  • The Moment: AI doesn't run without power, and that's us. Giga is the picks and shovels behind the AI revolution. This industry is about to explode, and you'll be in the room where it's already happening.

What Youâll Do

As Paralegal, youâll take full ownership of the NDA & intake process. Youâll drive NDAs to execution independently, without attorneys needing to be involved. Youâll maintain a centralized legal intake process â a single place where requests come in, get triaged, and get worked â and then hold the rest of the company accountable to using it. Youâll own the signature pipeline end to end: queuing documents, sending them out, and tracking them to completion. This is a highly autonomous role: youâll be given the outcome we need and trusted to enforce the process to get there, adapting as priorities shift.

This role starts as an individual contributor with real scope across every project at Giga, and thereâs a clear path to take on bigger, more complex work as you prove out the process.

Where youâll work

This role is remote. Travel is light â expect roughly 0â10%, mainly for occasional in-person team time.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end NDA process â draft, negotiate, and drive NDAs to execution independently, escalating to attorneys only on true edge cases.
  • Design and own a centralized legal intake process, replacing todayâs scattered mix of personal email, Slack channels and DMs, and texts with a single, clear front door for legal requests.

title: Product Designer
description:
Compensation: $160kâ190k base + meaningful equity

About Flint

The best education anyone has ever received is one person paying close attention to one student: moving at their pace, noticing what they missed, asking the next question at the right moment. But the current system is built around a compromise with one teacher managing thirty students.

Flint exists to take that compromise off the table. Personalized learning, at the scale of a whole school â every student working with something closer to a tutor, and every teacher able to see what's actually happening across their class instead of guessing.

Go look at the product before you read any further: app.flintk12.com

The Role

Students want something that stays with them, going at their pace and helps them get unstuck without just handing over the answer. Teachers want that happening inside a class they still control, and they'd like their evenings back. Admins want proof that the platform they rolled out is leading to teacher productivity and student progress.

Your job is to dive deep into this design problem, holding three sets of needs within one product. Weâll trust you to ship designs that are the best possible solution to our users most urgent pain points. tl;dr you'll get to own how Flint works and how it feels.

How We Work

  • We move fast, and closely. You'll work with a small, senior team: one Product Lead, a Chief of Staff (Product), a CTO, and five engineers. We also have a running joke that we canât keep up with our #product_updates channel because of how much we ship.
  • Fast and good aren't in tension here. In our experience the fastest route to something good is getting a rough version in front of a real teacher early, which tends to be quicker than getting it right in private. Decisions with the highest impact have often happened within days, not month long sprints.
  • Weâre always learning. Call it on-brand or a bit on the nose, but learning from each other, our customers, the market have been key to our growth. We even have channels dedicated to sharing our workflow mistakes and wins. Education is also still being actively shaped as a field, and staying tuned to what users and the industry are telling us matters more than assuming we already know.
  • Users drive our decisions. Our team isn't exclusively made up of former teachers, and that's deliberate. We'd rather build from real user feedback and a range of perspectives than from any one person's classroom experience. Our close connection with teachers, students, and admins helps us quickly understand what's working and what isn't.
  • We design with AI, not around it. Lo-fi concepts out of Claude, prototypes we can put in front of a teacher the same week, PRDs drafted from screenshots and voice notes: these are just a few ways weâve used AI to support our work, and it's a real part of why our loop is as short as it is.

What You'll Do

  • Dig deep, validate, and design. Validate the user goals, map key journeys, and land on the actual jobs to be done. People will hand you solutions along the way: the useful move is usually to find the need underneath before taking the solution at face value.
  • Explore broadly, then narrow. Iteration is key. For a complex UI, we'd expect five or six real concepts on the table before committing to one, whether it sketches, wireframes, AI-generated lo-fi, competitor and industry researchâ¦whatever gets you there fastest. Then you cut it down with your own judgment, a review with someone on the team, and wherever we can manage it, real users.
  • Design zero to one, and one to a hundred. Some of this is a genuinely new problem where you shape the whole thing from scratch. Some of it is taking something we shipped early and making it scalable, coherent, and delightful in the way the first version never had time to be.
  • Communicate your judgment effectively. You can clearly explain the context, intent, designs, and the reasoning behind your work to the rest of the team.
  • Set the design bar. Our design system and design philosophy are still taking form. You'll decide what becomes a pattern, what stays a one-off, and where the whole thing goes from here.
  • Stay through QA and impact. You'll have a say in what gets QA'd and in what metrics tell us whether the thing actually worked. Shipping isn't the end of your involvement.
  • Impact hundreds of thousands of learners. How a generation learns to think alongside AI is being decided right now, in the products that get built this year. Very few designers get to work on something this consequential this early.

What We're Looking For

  • You've designed and shipped real software. We care far more about one thing you made and can talk us through than about ten polished case-study slides.
  • You can run the whole arc, from understanding the problem through concepts, hi-fi, and a spec engineering can build from. Not every step has to be your strongest.
  • You're comfortable with being scrappy and being iterative. You'd rather put a rough thing in front of a real teacher than a perfect thing in front of your own team.
  • You want to shape a category-defining product. You're excited by building something that hasn't existed before and genuinely changes how people learn â not iterating on the margins of something that already works.
  • You're here to learn, not just to apply what you already know. That means sharpening your design skills and process on the job, and getting deep on the education industry itself, from US private Kâ12 to foreign education ministries and everything in between. You find that range interesting rather than intimidating.
  • You care about education. You should like what you are building and who you are building for!

What We Offer

  • Meaningful equity.
  • Health and dental insurance.
  • Personal device stipend.

How to Apply

Message Sun with your resume and portfolio, or apply here.

title: Onboarding Specialist
description:
INNERGY is transforming the woodworking industry with purpose built, cloud based ERP software designed exclusively for custom manufacturers. Our platform helps businesses operate smarter, faster, and more efficiently while seamlessly connecting design, production, and delivery for teams creating architectural millwork, cabinetry, and casework.

What truly sets INNERGY apart is our people. Founded in 2016, we are a globally distributed team of 200 plus professionals united by deep software expertise and a shared passion for solving meaningful, real world problems. We value collaboration, creativity, and ownership, and we are intentional about building not only powerful products, but also a culture where people feel supported, heard, and inspired to do their best work.

With strong momentum and the recent acquisition of Microvellum, a trusted leader in design to manufacturing solutions for the woodworking industry, INNERGY is entering an exciting new phase of growth. This combination expands our capabilities, deepens our industry impact, and accelerates our vision of delivering a truly connected, end to end platform for custom manufacturers.

As we scale thoughtfully and bring together top talent and new perspectives, this is a unique opportunity to join a company where your work will have visible impact, your ideas will help shape decisions, and your contributions will play a meaningful role in defining the future of a fast evolving product, team, and industry.

Job Description

In this role, you will guide clients through our structured onboarding process, ensuring they adopt INNERGY effectively and achieve measurable business value early in their journey.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Client Onboarding: Manage the onboarding process for new clients by setting clear expectations, defining milestones, and tracking progress against onboarding goals.
  • Education & Enablement: Support client education by integrating learning opportunities into onboarding and collaborating with the Content Creation team to prioritize and request the training resources clients need most.
  • Process Monitoring: Use data and progress tracking to monitor client health during onboarding, identifying and addressing potential challenges early.
  • Client Motivation: Keep clients engaged and motivated throughout onboarding, encouraging adoption of INNERGY processes and best practices.
  • Communication: Maintain clear, consistent communication with clients, providing regular updates and documenting all interactions for cross-team visibility.
  • Problem Solving: Identify and address challenges such as limited client engagement or resistance to change. Develop strategies to overcome these obstacles and keep onboarding on track.
  • Feedback Loop: Gather client feedback throughout onboarding and share insights to help refine onboarding strategies and influence future training content priorities.

Qualifications

  • Experience in onboarding, client success, or related roles, preferably within Microvellum architectural millwork industry, or manufacturing.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
